turns.assessment: The simultaneous loss of six channels fans out downstream of S09: channels disappear on S09→S15 and S09→S12, then remain absent toward S04, while the incoming S05→S09 channel monitor and all amplifiers on that span show no change. This localizes the interruption to the S09 ROADM input handling channels arriving from S05. A failed WSS input port explains the multi-channel loss across multiple outgoing degrees; individual transceiver, amplifier, connector, or fibre faults do not.

proposals.rationale: The optical signal is present through the S05→S09 line but multiple channels are absent after S09 on both the S15 and S12 outgoing routes. A WSS input-port failure at S09 blocks every channel arriving on that degree while allowing channels on other inputs to remain unaffected, matching the observations.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

clarify.assessment: The failed WSS input port is the S09 degree receiving the S05→S09 line. Light remains normal through that line, while multiple channels disappear after S09 across different outgoing routes; this localizes the block to oms.S05-S09|port rather than ports receiving from S15 or S12.
